plugins.name: idle-stop
plugins.description: Stops a server when its last player leaves, and adds a live player list, kick, ban, ban list, a clear-bans/clear-session reset and instant on-join welcome messages (on by default). Supports Source/GoldSrc (A2S/RCON), Minecraft (RCON) and Valheim (ValheimRcon RCON, default port 2458, showMessage welcomes). Includes admin and server tabs.
plugins.author: SpiritNetworks
